name: sigil
description: Grafana Sigil SDK bridge for LLM observability

tools.name: sigil_start_generation
tools.description: Start a generation span for LLM observability. Returns a generation ID and context that should be used with other sigil tools.

tools.name: sigil_end_generation
tools.description: End a generation span and export it to Grafana Sigil.

tools.name: sigil_set_result
tools.description: Set the result for a generation (messages, tool calls).

tools.name: sigil_start_tool_execution
tools.description: Start a tool execution span for observability.

tools.name: sigil_end_tool_execution
tools.description: End a tool execution span and export it to Grafana Sigil.
